summary: This bill reauthorizes and amends the Beaches Environmental Assessment and Coastal Health Act to extend grants for water quality monitoring at coastal recreation waters, including nearby shallow upstream waters, and allows these grants to be used for identifying specific sources of contamination, while also updating guidance to reflect new testing technologies.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on improving water quality monitoring and notification for coastal recreation waters, including identifying sources of contamination. This directly contributes to environmental protection by enhancing the ability to detect and address water pollution.
